inventedEvidence.evidence: 'especially since you have cats' - the customer only mentioned cat litter, never said they own cats (the dog hair fact was also ignored)

rationale: The assistant correctly diagnosed airflow restriction, guided the customer to find the wand blockage, and the fault was fixed with no part recommended. However, it never encouraged washing the never-washed filter, only mentioning drying 'if you ever do wash', which is a missed opportunity. It also asserted 'since you have cats', which the customer never said (they mentioned cat litter). It repeated the 'switch off and unplug' line at the end of the final message, which is odd after a fix, and it inaccurately framed the safety cutout as 'protecting itself from overheating'.
